description: This file defines a 'ProductCard' component for a shopping app frontend, using the LightningJS framework. It specifies the visual layout, state, computed properties, and methods related to displaying product details and managing quantity selection and cart addition.

classes.name: ProductCard
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a product display card with UI elements, state management, and interaction methods.

methods.name: $increment
methods.description: Increases the product quantity by one, up to the maximum stock or 99.

methods.name: $decrement
methods.description: Decreases the product quantity by one, minimum of 1.

methods.name: $addToCart
methods.description: Adds the current product and selected quantity to the cart and provides visual feedback via alpha change.
